unit.name: Entry points, prerequisites, and when deep learning matters in products
unit.description: Clarifies how CS230 differs from nearby courses and explains why applied builders often need more than prompting to ship useful AI systems.
unit.summary: The first question block clarifies that machine learning is not a hard prerequisite, though students without prior ML may feel the first weeks move quickly [ts=742s] [ts=763s]. Ng compares CS129, CS229, and CS230 as different on-ramps, positioning CS230 as the most applied deep-learning-focused option and CS229 as the more mathematical and broader ML theory course [ts=779s] [ts=858s]. He also says the class is intentionally practical rather than beauty-through-proof math, with emphasis on building software that works [ts=1068s] [ts=1121s]. That practical lens continues into product advice: prompting is strong for text, but many real systems still need direct deep learning for audio, vision, video, and structured data, and fine-tuning smaller models matters when prompt iteration stalls or inference bills explode [ts=1199s] [ts=1364s].

key_points.text: Machine learning is not a hard prerequisite; CS129, CS229, and CS230 are different entry points with different tradeoffs.
CS230 is relatively applied and math-light compared with CS229.
For many industry roles, fine-tuning pretrained transformers is more relevant than training frontier LLMs from scratch.
Prompting works well for text, but direct deep learning is often needed for audio, images, video, and structured data.
When prompt tuning plateaus or LLM serving costs explode, fine-tuning smaller models becomes valuable.

kp_catalog.name: Choosing between prompting and direct deep learning by data modality
kp_catalog.description: The lecture distinguishes cases where prompting large language models works well from cases where practitioners still need direct deep-learning methods, especially outside pure text.
kp_catalog.importance_rationale: This distinction grounds the course in real product choices, with text-heavy prompting contrasted against direct deep-learning work on audio, images, video, and structured data [ts=1199s]-[ts=1260s].
